inventory: Existing rotation scalar/vector CUDA branches compose tagged scalar shuffle only at SM7+, preserving established lower-target branches.
One new provider helper _emitWaveReadLaneAt: exact catalog signatures; validates every actual operand before mutation;32-bit path delegates unchanged; narrower/64-bit values use bit transport.
Nine additional scalar catalog signatures with three scalar descriptor constants; no new provider operation or ABI.
self_review.input_shape: Valid WaveRotate/WaveClusteredRotate source used untagged prelude GenericAsm. Producer composition owns lane arithmetic; scalar tagged WaveMaskReadLaneAt already provides canonical semantic identity. Exact scalar widths remain canonical values and provider owns legalizing native shuffle width.
self_review.bit_transport: Narrow values zero-extend low bits then truncate back;64-bit low/high words use identical original mask/index and clamp31, then zero-extend/reassemble. Floating values bitcast without numeric conversion.
negative_gates: Three malformed mask/payload/lane semantic signatures rejected before fake provider loading/mutation.
Every newly admitted scalar payload rejects wrong actual LLVM type; UInt64 additionally rejects wrong actual mask/lane types. Serialized module equals clean control.
self_review.alternatives: Rotation-specific semantic IDs or source-text parsing would duplicate lane arithmetic already expressible using canonical operations. Existing vector prelude consumer admits32-bit values only, so vector composition uses scalar component calls. Public capability remainsSM5; older branches retained because existing lane-query/shuffle API requiresSM7.

final_source_and_binary_hash_recheck: All recorded source and artifact hashes match after final gates; fixtures byte-identical to before runs.

validation_history.explanation: Initial all-CUDA composition exceeded existing SM5 rotation capability; retained legacy branches and used the SM7 capability atom. No partial runtime result is used as acceptance.

formatting.unit_tests: Installed clang-format17 limited to added lines; historical surrounding formatting retained.

parent_acceptance.independent_raw_preservation_review: exactly four repaired old rotation cells; six correct additions; no other classification, return-code, execution-count, diagnostic or canonical-shape changes
